namespace: Delegate independent background tasks, exchange messages, and collect their results.

parameters.context: Background, constraints, and source material shared by every task in this batch.
parameters.tasks: Independent tasks. Order is preserved in the result, but it does not create execution dependencies.
parameters.name: Caller-facing label; defaults to none.
parameters.task: Self-contained assignment: deliverable, scope, and how to verify completion.
parameters.inheritContext: Copy this session's conversation, system prompt, model, and thinking at creation time. Default false: start without this session's chat history.
parameters.all: Show every agent, including Main and stopped agents, without group limits. Default false.
parameters.filterId: Optional agent id to filter the visible list. Use all: true to query outside the default view.
parameters.messagePath: Returned Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe address.
parameters.messageContent: Plain-text message body. The host frames the transport and binds the sender.

create.description: Create independent background agents. Returns each agent's id, status, socket, and history paths; does not wait for results.
create.snippet: Delegate independent tasks to background agents
create.guideline: Write requirements for subagents primarily in English.

list.description: List the parent, peers (including self), and own children. Each group is capped at the per-parent concurrency limit: active first, then most recently stopped. Main also expands visible active children; stopped nodes and peers are not expanded. Set all: true for every agent. Main has no subagent history paths. Does not wait for completion.
list.snippet: Check background agent progress and history paths

stop.description: Request cancellation of an agent by id. May return stopping or finalizing while execution or history writes finish; does not wait for shutdown.
stop.snippet: Cancel a background agent's current run

message.description: Send a plain-text message to a managed Agent IPC endpoint: Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe. The host binds the sender and transport framing. Omit from/to, JSON or NDJSON envelopes, and trailing newlines. Cannot write files.
message.snippet: Send plain-text messages to agents through their Socket paths
guidelines: Provide the message body as plain text content; do not add from/to, JSON/NDJSON framing, a trailing newline, or a custom Socket client.
